## Project Info
- **CMS**: Torch CMS
- **API Base URL**: https://api.madebyhaithem.com
- **Documentation**: https://api.madebyhaithem.com/documentation
- **Authentication**: JWT Bearer Token (for protected endpoints)
- **Public APIs**: No authentication required for content retrieval

## API Endpoints

### Content API (Public - No Auth Required)
| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/_api/collections` | List all available collections |
| GET | `/_api/content/{collection}` | Get all items from a collection |
| GET | `/_api/content/{collection}/{slug}` | Get a single item by slug |

**Query Parameters for `/_api/content/{collection}`:**
- `page` (number) - Page number for pagination (default: 1)
- `limit` (number) - Items per page (default: 20, max: 100)
- `sort` (string) - Field to sort by (prefix with - for descending)
- `status` (string) - Filter by status: "published" or "draft"

### Forms API (Public - No Auth Required)
| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/_api/forms/{slug}` | Get form definition with fields |
| POST | `/_api/forms/{slug}/submit` | Submit form data |

### Analytics API (Public - No Auth Required)
| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | `/analytics/session` | Create a new analytics session |
| POST | `/analytics/pageview` | Track a page view |
| POST | `/analytics/track` | Batch track custom events |
| PUT | `/analytics/session/{id}` | Update session on page leave |

### Media API (Auth Required)
| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| GET | `/media/{fileId}/transform` | Get transformed image |
| GET | `/hls/videos/{fileId}/master.m3u8` | Get HLS video stream |

### Contact API (Public - No Auth Required)
| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | `/contacts` | Submit contact form |

## TypeScript Type Definitions

```typescript
// Base types for all collection items
interface BaseCollectionItem {
  id: string;
  slug: string;
  status: 'draft' | 'published';
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  publishedAt: string | null;
}

// API Response wrapper
interface ApiResponse<T> {
  items: T[];
  total: number;
  page: number;
  limit: number;
  totalPages: number;
}

// Single item response
interface SingleItemResponse<T> {
  item: T;
}

// Collection Types

interface ProjectsData {
    images: unknown;
    title: unknown;
    description: unknown;
    tags?: unknown;
    featured: unknown;
}

interface ProjectsItem extends BaseCollectionItem {
  collectionId: string;
  data: ProjectsData;
}

```
## Code Examples

### Fetching Collection Items (React with React Query)

```tsx
import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';

const API_URL = 'https://api.madebyhaithem.com';

// Generic hook for any collection
function useCollection<T>(slug: string, options?: { page?: number; limit?: number }) {
  return useQuery({
    queryKey: ['collection', slug, options],
    queryFn: async () => {
      const params = new URLSearchParams();
      if (options?.page) params.set('page', String(options.page));
      if (options?.limit) params.set('limit', String(options.limit));
      params.set('status', 'published');

      const res = await fetch(`${API_URL}/_api/content/${slug}?${params}`);
      if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to fetch');
      return res.json() as Promise<ApiResponse<T>>;
    },
  });
}

// Usage
function BlogList() {
  const { data, isLoading, error } = useCollection<BlogPostItem>('blog-posts');

  if (isLoading) return <div>Loading...</div>;
  if (error) return <div>Error loading posts</div>;

  return (
    <ul>
      {data?.items.map(post => (
        <li key={post.id}>{post.data.title}</li>
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

### Submitting a Form

```tsx
async function submitForm(formSlug: string, data: Record<string, unknown>) {
  const response = await fetch(`https://api.madebyhaithem.com/_api/forms/${formSlug}/submit`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const error = await response.json();
    throw new Error(error.message || 'Form submission failed');
  }

  return response.json();
}

// Usage with React Hook Form
function ContactForm() {
  const { register, handleSubmit, formState: { isSubmitting } } = useForm();

  const onSubmit = async (data) => {
    try {
      await submitForm('contact', data);
      alert('Thank you for your message!');
    } catch (error) {
      alert('Submission failed. Please try again.');
    }
  };

  return (
    <form onSubmit={handleSubmit(onSubmit)}>
      <input {...register('name', { required: true })} placeholder="Name" />
      <input {...register('email', { required: true })} type="email" placeholder="Email" />
      <textarea {...register('message', { required: true })} placeholder="Message" />
      <button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting}>Send</button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

### Vanilla JavaScript Fetch

```javascript
// Fetch all items from a collection
async function getCollectionItems(collectionSlug, options = {}) {
  const params = new URLSearchParams({
    status: 'published',
    ...options,
  });

  const response = await fetch(
    `https://api.madebyhaithem.com/_api/content/${collectionSlug}?${params}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}

// Get a single item by slug
async function getItemBySlug(collectionSlug, itemSlug) {
  const response = await fetch(
    `https://api.madebyhaithem.com/_api/content/${collectionSlug}/${itemSlug}`
  );

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`HTTP error! status: ${response.status}`);
  }

  return response.json();
}
```

## Authentication

Most content APIs are **public** and don't require authentication. However, some endpoints (like media management) require JWT authentication.

### Obtaining a Token

```javascript
const response = await fetch('https://api.madebyhaithem.com/auth/login', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    email: 'user@example.com',
    password: 'password'
  })
});

const { token, refreshToken } = await response.json();
```

### Using the Token

```javascript
const response = await fetch('https://api.madebyhaithem.com/some-protected-endpoint', {
  headers: {
    'Authorization': `Bearer ${token}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json'
  }
});
```

### Token Refresh

Tokens expire after a set time. Use the refresh token to get a new access token:

```javascript
const response = await fetch('https://api.madebyhaithem.com/auth/refresh', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ refreshToken })
});

const { token: newToken } = await response.json();
```

## Rate Limits

The API has tiered rate limiting based on endpoint sensitivity:

| Tier | Limit | Endpoints |
|------|-------|-----------|
| **Strict** | 5 req/min | Login, password reset |
| **Moderate** | 20 req/min | Protected write operations |
| **Lenient** | 100 req/min | Public read endpoints |
| **Auth** | 3 attempts/5 min | Login attempts |

**Rate Limit Headers:**
- `X-RateLimit-Limit` - Maximum requests allowed
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining` - Requests remaining in window
- `X-RateLimit-Reset` - Time when the limit resets

**Handling Rate Limits:**
```javascript
async function fetchWithRetry(url, options, maxRetries = 3) {
  for (let i = 0; i < maxRetries; i++) {
    const response = await fetch(url, options);

    if (response.status === 429) {
      const retryAfter = response.headers.get('Retry-After') || '60';
      await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, parseInt(retryAfter) * 1000));
      continue;
    }

    return response;
  }
  throw new Error('Max retries exceeded');
}
```

## Response Format

All API responses follow a consistent JSON structure:

### Success Response
```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": { ... },
  "message": "Optional success message"
}
```

### Error Response
```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Human readable error message",
    "details": { ... }
  }
}
```

### Collection List Response
```json
{
  "items": [...],
  "total": 100,
  "page": 1,
  "limit": 20,
  "totalPages": 5
}
```

## Tips for LLM Usage

1. **Always use the exact API base URL**: `https://api.madebyhaithem.com`
2. **Content endpoints are public**: No auth needed for /_api/content/* or /_api/forms/*
3. **Use status=published**: Always filter by published status for public websites
4. **Handle pagination**: Use page and limit params for large collections
5. **TypeScript types are available**: Copy the type definitions above for type safety
6. **Rate limits apply**: Implement retry logic for production applications

## Quick Reference

- List collections: `GET https://api.madebyhaithem.com/_api/collections`
- Get collection items: `GET https://api.madebyhaithem.com/_api/content/{slug}?status=published`
- Get single item: `GET https://api.madebyhaithem.com/_api/content/{slug}/{itemSlug}`
- Get form: `GET https://api.madebyhaithem.com/_api/forms/{slug}`
- Submit form: `POST https://api.madebyhaithem.com/_api/forms/{slug}/submit`
- Swagger docs: https://api.madebyhaithem.com/documentation
